newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Surgutneftegaz votes more shares, charter changes.
newsitem.headline: Surgutneftegaz votes more shares, charter changes.

text.p: Shareholders in Russia's AO Surgutneftegaz voted this weekend to increase charter capital and give existing shareholders first option on new share issues, the company's press service said on Monday.
It said shareholders in AO Surgutneftegaz approved an increase in charter capital to 6.16 trillion roubles from 6.0 trillion through an issue of 166 million preference shares.
The actual issue will take place only after approval from the company's board of directors.
Existing shareholders would be the first to be allowed to bid for the new shares, the press service said.
About three quarters of AO Surgutneftegaz is controlled by NK Surgutneftegaz oil company.
